classData.comment:
/**
 * @summary Shared timeline event store with interval range queries.
 * @description Extends `Neo.data.Store` with `Neo.timeline.model.Event` and provides
 * `getRangeRecords(start, end, resourceId)` (plus static `Events.getRangeRecords(store, start, end, resourceId)`)
 * to query all single-day, multi-day, and zero-duration milestone records whose `[startDate, endDate)` interval
 * intersects `[start, end)`. Range queries scan linearly and `Neo.timeline.util.IntervalPacker` sorts its own working
 * copy, so shared stores that are unsorted or sorted by another domain field work without requiring ascending
 * `startDate`.
 * @class Neo.timeline.store.Events
 * @extends Neo.data.Store
 */
classData.summary: Shared timeline event store with interval range queries.
classData.description: Extends Neo.data.Store with Neo.timeline.model.Event and provides getRangeRecords(start, end, resourceId) (plus static Events.getRangeRecords(store, start, end, resourceId)) to query all single-day, multi-day, and zero-duration milestone records whose [startDate, endDate) interval intersects [start, end). Range queries scan linearly and Neo.timeline.util.IntervalPacker sorts its own working copy, so shared stores that are unsorted or sorted by another domain field work without requiring ascending startDate.
